# a-paradigm

> This project uses Paradigm for structured AI-assisted development.
> All context, symbols, and specifications live in the .paradigm/ directory.

## Symbols

| Prefix | Name | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `#` | Component | Any documented code unit (feature, service, module, integration) |
| `$` | Flow | Multi-step processes or user journeys |
| `^` | Gate | Access control points and authorization rules |
| `!` | Signal | Events emitted for side effects |
| `~` | Aspect | Cross-cutting rules with required code anchors |

## Key Files

### Config

- `.paradigm/config.yaml`
- `package.json`

## Flows

- **$$init-flow**: Project Initialization (trigger: `paradigm init`)
- **$$sync-flow**: IDE Sync (trigger: `paradigm sync`)
- **$$probe-flow**: Visual Discovery (trigger: `paradigm probe <screenshot>`)
- **$$authorization-flow**: Gate Authorization (trigger: `HTTP request to protected route`)
- **$$orchestration-flow**: Multi-Agent Orchestration (trigger: `paradigm team orchestrate <task>`)
- **$$purpose-parsing**: Purpose File Parsing (trigger: `File read of *.purpose`)
- **$$incident-triage**: Incident Triage (trigger: `Error/exception captured by Sentinel transport`)
- **$$plsat-exam-flow**: PLSAT Certification Exam (trigger: `Student starts PLSAT exam`)
- **$$handoff-roundtrip**: Session Handoff (trigger: `Agent calls paradigm_handoff_prepare`)
- **$$wisdom-promotion**: Wisdom Promotion (trigger: `paradigm_wisdom_promote`)

## Gates

| Gate | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `^local-only` | Server binds to localhost only — no external access |
| `^authenticated-session` | Route requires an active Paradigm session (platform server running) |
| `^read-only` | Route only returns data — no side effects or state mutations |
| `^write-capable` | Route modifies state — creates, updates, or deletes data |

## Conventions

- Use kebab-case for all symbol IDs (feature-name, not featureName)
- Document flows when logic spans 3+ components
- Reference related items using symbol prefixes (# $ ^ ! ~)
- Add descriptions to all components and gates
- Update .purpose files when changing feature behavior
- Keep gates minimal - one responsibility per gate
- Use signals for side effects, not direct state mutations
- ALWAYS use Paradigm logger, NEVER raw console.log/print
